notes: This portable C++ TCK slice composes two adapter-supplied FOM modules and the standard MIM. A joined subject publishes one standard HLAbyte attribute in each of two distinct object classes, registers two instances per class, and successfully invokes six receive-order updates, including repeated updates to one instance of each class. An actively subscribed observer validates all four discoveries and six reflect callbacks; a distinct joined requester queries the subject's standard HLAreportObjectInstancesUpdated interaction. The requester decodes HLAobjectClassBasedCounts and requires two distinct updated instances for each class. Nested count records use standard HLAinteger32BE, HLAoctet, HLAfixedRecord, and HLAvariableArray data elements with the public object-class handle decoder. Provider package, FOM modules, application class and attribute names, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs. No DDM region services are invoked. Source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs and the C++ standard library, with no private headers, provider registry access, or vendor-specific names.
